name: DeepResearchBench
intro: DeepResearch Bench 从 96,147 条真实用户查询估计 22 个领域的研究需求分布，由领域专家构建 100 个单语博士级任务（中文 50、英文 50），并用 RACE 与 FACT 分别评估报告质量和引用检索质量。
org: University of Science and Technology of China; Metastone Technology
build_method: 真实查询分布分析, 领域专家构建, 人工筛选
metric: RACE 总分与四维分数, 引用准确率, 每题有效引用数
task_type: 研究Agent任务, 信息综合
eval_feature: 参考报告自适应评测, 引用事实支持检查, 人类一致性验证
build_method_en: Real-query Distribution Analysis, Domain-expert Construction, Manual Screening
eval_feature_en: Reference-based Adaptive Evaluation, Citation Support Checking, Human-alignment Validation
intro_en: DeepResearch Bench estimates demand across 22 fields from 96,147 real user queries, curates 100 monolingual PhD-level tasks (50 Chinese and 50 English) with domain experts, and evaluates report quality and citation retrieval with RACE and FACT.
metric_en: RACE Overall and Four Dimensions, Citation Accuracy, Effective Citations per Task

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.11763v1, initial official repository release 214741e474a5347ea7f869ab79d27e7c8734ede7, query JSONL SHA256 62b197a264a027fd4e2e795ff322a82dd6d566f5e350596ccc7572539ec987d1, and official Hugging Face artifact revision f7d27cdd3930dd1eaf67a217821e616cc62e9f8e. This is the USTC/Metastone 100-task DeepResearch Bench with RACE and FACT, not a similarly named benchmark. The paper anonymizes 96,147 search-chat queries, filters 44,019 deep-research queries with DeepSeek-V3-0324, estimates demand across 22 domains, and proportionally compresses it to 100 monolingual evaluation prompts: 50 Chinese and 50 English, with each task written in exactly one language and no train/dev/test split. Agent search trajectories are system-defined and are not benchmark-labeled; evaluation consumes the final cited report. Paper-v1 RACE uses Gemini-2.5-pro, adaptive dimension and criterion weights, an April-2025 reference report, and S_final = S_int(target)/(S_int(target)+S_int(reference)). FACT uses Gemini-2.5-flash, statement-URL deduplication, Jina Reader support judgment, Citation Accuracy as the mean of per-task N_s,t/N_u,t with zero for empty tasks, and E. Cit = sum N_s,t/|T|. Human validation covers 50 Chinese tasks, four agents, three experts per task, 70+ domain experts, 225 person-hours, and an ICC-filtered 37-task subset. Version boundary: current main 469cce54ea7f6a63c163d3d9fec879cf289ec484 switched to GPT-5.5/GPT-5.4-mini on 2026-05-11; that post-paper drift is documented but excluded from the paper-v1 flow.
